blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The newly signed Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) should, first and foremost, be of benefit to Southeast Asia’s micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), a business executive said. Joey Concepcion, chair of the Asean Business Advisory Council, said making cross-border trade easier for MSMEs would help streamline broader trade across the region and connect its digital systems under Defa. “What works for the smallest businesses can also work for the largest companies,” Concepcion said following the signing of Defa by Asean leaders on Saturday. “If we can make cross-border trade simple, efficient and secure enough for MSMEs, we create […]...
